'''Charotke Chel''' was a [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] who residing on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]] during the [[Galactic War]]. He passed his knowledge a [[Hunter (individual)|bounty hunter]] who had won the [[Great Hunt (c. 3643 BBY)|Great Hunt]].
